title: How to use Udemy's course features (video playback, Q&A, notes, captions, etc)

cues.en: If you are new to Udemy, then I hope you find this video instructive and useful.
cues.zh: 如果你第一次使用 Udemy，希望這段影片能提供實用的操作說明。

cues.en: And even if you've used Udemy before, then I hope you still find something new in this video.
cues.zh: 即使以前用過 Udemy，也希望你能從這段影片發現新東西。

cues.en: So here we see the main video player here, and all of the course content over here on the right.
cues.zh: 這裡是主要影片播放器，右邊是所有課程內容。

cues.en: If you click on one of the sections that will take you to a list of videos, you can see that you can watch any video in any order.
cues.zh: 點進其中一章，就會看到影片清單。你可以用任何順序觀看任何影片。

cues.en: Now, I do recommend going through the course in the order in which the videos appear, because that is how I created the course.
cues.zh: 不過，我建議依照影片排列順序上課，因為這是我設計課程的順序。

cues.en: Over here we have a standard player.
cues.zh: 這裡是一般的播放器，

cues.en: There's a play button.
cues.zh: 有播放按鈕。

cues.en: You can also click anywhere on the window to play or pause the video.
cues.zh: 也可以點影片視窗的任何位置來播放或暫停。

cues.en: Here is a nice option.
cues.zh: 這裡有個很方便的選項，

cues.en: You can change the playback speed.
cues.zh: 能調整播放速度。

cues.en: Now I record all of my courses, speaking slowly to accommodate for non-English speakers who may not be so comfortable with English.
cues.zh: 我錄製所有課程時，都刻意放慢語速，照顧可能不太熟悉英文、母語不是英文的學員。

cues.en: If you are comfortable with English, then feel free to increase the video speed here.
cues.zh: 如果你很熟悉英文，隨時可以在這裡加快影片速度。

cues.en: Here is a nice option for add notes.
cues.zh: 這裡的 Add Notes 也很好用。

cues.en: If there is something that is important that you want to remember in the video at exactly this time.
cues.zh: 如果影片此刻有重要的內容，希望記下來，

cues.en: Okay, maybe nothing important happens at zero zero, but let's say over here, maybe there's something important that I'm saying in the video here, and you want to make a note of it so you can write a note
cues.zh: 好，0:00 可能還沒什麼重點，但假設這個位置，我講到一些重要內容，你想做筆記，就能在，

cues.en: here, whatever notes you want.
cues.zh: 這裡寫下任何想記的事。

cues.en: You can change the style this to be for having a heading.
cues.zh: 可以修改樣式，例如改成標題。

cues.en: You can use bold or italics.
cues.zh: 可以用粗體或斜體。

cues.en: You can make the font look like code by pressing this button over here.
cues.zh: 也能按這裡的按鈕，讓文字呈現程式碼的樣式。

cues.en: And then you save the note that will appear as a actually got still ended up here a yellow bar you can see.
cues.zh: 儲存筆記後就會顯示在這裡。其實最後還是在這裡，你能看到黃色的標記。

cues.en: Here's another note that I was making when I was testing.
cues.zh: 這是我測試時寫的另一則筆記。

cues.en: Over here you have the sound volume here.
cues.zh: 這裡能調整音量。

cues.en: This is an option to show the transcript, so you can have a transcript of everything that is said in the video.
cues.zh: 這個選項能顯示逐字稿，讓影片說的所有內容都，

cues.en: Off to the right.
cues.zh: 出現在右邊。

cues.en: I prefer to have captions here sometimes.
cues.zh: 我有時比較喜歡在這裡開啟字幕。

cues.en: Udemy will also provide captions translated into other languages.
cues.zh: Udemy 也會提供翻成其他語言的字幕。

cues.en: This is not something that I do.
cues.zh: 這不是我做的，

cues.en: This is something that Udemy does for certain videos.
cues.zh: 而是 Udemy 針對某些影片提供的功能。

cues.en: Here you have the settings option.
cues.zh: 這裡是設定選項。

cues.en: Now if you find that your video is blurry, that is Udemy lowering the resolution because it has determined that you have a slow internet connection.
cues.zh: 如果你覺得影片模糊，是 Udemy 判斷網速較慢，所以降低了解析度。

cues.en: So if that's happening, you can try to manually increase the resolution.
cues.zh: 遇到這種情況，可以試著手動提高解析度。

cues.en: Just be aware that if your internet connection isn't so great, then forcing the resolution to be higher might actually cause the video to buffer a little bit.
cues.zh: 只是要注意，如果網路不太好，強制提高解析度，可能讓影片需要稍微緩衝一下。

cues.en: Now I want to show you a few options down here.
cues.zh: 接著想介紹下面幾個選項。

cues.en: This is the Q&A section.
cues.zh: 這是 Q&A 問答區。

cues.en: This is one of my favorite parts of teaching on Udemy.
cues.zh: 這是我在 Udemy 教課最喜歡的部分之一。

cues.en: There is an active Q&A forum that you can use to post questions.
cues.zh: 這裡有活躍的問答討論區，可以發問。

cues.en: I try to respond to all questions within a day or two days.
cues.zh: 我會盡量在一到兩天內回覆所有問題。

cues.en: You can search through questions, for example about batch normalization.
cues.zh: 可以搜尋問題，例如 batch normalization。

cues.en: So there are 63 questions posed in this course that include the term batch.
cues.zh: 這門課裡有 63 個問題包含 batch 這個詞。

cues.en: Now this is showing 900 questions in total across all lectures.
cues.zh: 現在顯示的是所有講座合計 900 個問題。

cues.en: A really nice feature is to select current lecture.
cues.zh: 一個很方便的功能，是選 Current Lecture。

cues.en: And you can see that there are four discussions that I have had with students only on this particular lecture.
cues.zh: 可以看到，光這一堂課，我就和學員進行過四個討論。

cues.en: This is a really great way to supplement your learning, and to make sure you're getting a lot out of this course.
cues.zh: 這很適合補充學習，確保你能從這門課獲得豐富收穫。

cues.en: If you have a question, please, please, please first search through the course questions to see if your question was already posted.
cues.zh: 如果有問題，拜託一定先搜尋課程問答，看看是否已經有人問過。

cues.en: It starts taking up a lot of my time.
cues.zh: 如果我必須，

cues.en: If I have to answer the same question over and over again.
cues.zh: 反覆回答相同問題，會花很多時間。

cues.en: So please search for your question.
cues.zh: 所以，請先搜尋自己的問題。

cues.en: If your question is not there, then of course I welcome you to post a new topic.
cues.zh: 如果找不到，當然歡迎你發起新主題。

cues.en: You can do that by scrolling down to the bottom and click on Ask a New Question.
cues.zh: 往下捲到最下面，點 Ask a New Question 即可。

cues.en: If the question is not related to course content, if it's something about the Udemy platform, you need to contact Udemy support.
cues.zh: 如果問題和課程內容無關，而是 Udemy 平台的問題，需要聯絡 Udemy 客服。

cues.en: If it's a question about the course content, then you can select course content.
cues.zh: 如果是課程內容的問題，可以選 Course Content。

cues.en: You have the option to include a title.
cues.zh: 這裡可以填標題。

cues.en: Please use an informative title.
cues.zh: 請使用能清楚表達問題的標題。

cues.en: This is not only to help me, it's also to help other students benefit from and contribute to the Q&A.
cues.zh: 這不只是幫助我，也讓其他學員能從問答受益，或一起參與。

cues.en: Here you can write in more detail, and please provide enough detail that I can actually help you.
cues.zh: 這裡可以寫詳細內容，請提供足夠的細節，讓我確實能幫忙。

cues.en: If I get a question like Mike, my code isn't working help, then there's really nothing I can do.
cues.zh: 如果只寫「Mike，我的程式不能動，救命」，我實在做不了什麼。

cues.en: Please give a timestamp of the video you can paste in code I've already shown you.
cues.zh: 請提供影片時間點，也能貼上程式碼。剛才已經示範，

cues.en: This is how to use this code formatting tool.
cues.zh: 怎麼使用程式碼格式工具。

cues.en: Here you can take a screenshot of how your computer looks and include that screenshot.
cues.zh: 也可以擷取電腦畫面的截圖，附在這裡。

cues.en: The more information you can provide to me, the better I can help you with whatever question you have.
cues.zh: 提供的資訊越多，我就越能協助解決你的問題。

cues.en: One more thing I want to mention about the Q&A forum is that this is not only an opportunity for one student to get one answer from me.
cues.zh: 關於問答區，還想提醒：這不只是讓一位學員得到我的一個答案。

cues.en: If you see someone else posting a question or a comment or showing some code if you.
cues.zh: 如果看到別人發問、留言，或展示程式碼，而你，

cues.en: Feel like you can contribute to that conversation, please do so.
cues.zh: 覺得自己能參與討論，請踴躍加入。

cues.en: That would be a great way to benefit the entire course and all the future students in this course.
cues.zh: 這樣能讓整門課和未來所有學員都受益。

cues.en: The very last thing I want to mention in this video is about providing a rating and an evaluation for the course.
cues.zh: 這段影片最後要提的是替課程評分、撰寫評價。

cues.en: Udemy will ask you to rate the course after.
cues.zh: Udemy 會在你看過，

cues.en: I think it's usually around 10 to 15 minutes of video.
cues.zh: 我想通常大約 10 到 15 分鐘後，請你評分。

cues.en: I know it's very fast, but that's how it works.
cues.zh: 我知道很快，但平台就是這樣運作。

cues.en: You can feel free to select the option for Ask Me later on your window.
cues.zh: 你可以在視窗裡選 Ask Me Later。

cues.en: You will see a menu option here with three buttons.
cues.zh: 這裡會看到一個三個按鈕的選單選項。

cues.en: Now I don't see it here because Udemy doesn't allow instructors to rate their own courses.
cues.zh: 我這裡看不到，因為 Udemy 不允許講師替自己的課程評分。

cues.en: You can click on that and that will allow you to provide a review of the course.
cues.zh: 點它就能提供課程評價。

cues.en: If you want to provide a written review, that would be really great.
cues.zh: 如果願意寫文字評論，真的很好，

cues.en: I would really appreciate it.
cues.zh: 我會非常感謝。

cues.en: And it also helps future students decide whether this course is right for them.
cues.zh: 也能幫助未來的學員判斷，這門課是否適合自己。
